any.name: Thrown shoe
any.text: Dolly throws a shoe. You walk her to a farrier who charges by the sigh.
any.saved_text: Dolly throws a shoe. You tack on a spare, only slightly sideways.

any.name: Rattlesnake
any.text: A rattlesnake objects to the traffic. {name} leaves the saddle at speed.
any.saved_text: A rattlesnake objects. {name} leaves the saddle, and the first-aid kit handles the landing.

any.name: Dolly says no
any.text: Dolly stops at a creek she has crossed a hundred times and declines. You wait her out.

any.name: She knows the bar
any.text: Dolly walks straight to a roadside bar from memory. {name} says it would be rude not to go in.

any.name: Open gate
any.text: A rancher waves you through his pasture. Cars can't follow and you feel superior.

any.name: Parade
any.text: You wander into a small-town parade and get paid to stay in it.

any.name: GPS shortcut
any.text: The GPS says 'turn left' with total confidence. Left is a two-track ending at a stock tank and one disappointed cow.
any.saved_text: The GPS says 'turn left' into a stock tank. {name} checks the paper atlas and vetoes the robot.

any.name: Recalculating
any.text: The GPS loses signal, panics and sends you back the way you came. Nobody notices for half an hour.
any.saved_text: The GPS loses signal. {name} unfolds the paper atlas like a hero, and refolds it like a villain.

any.name: Wrong Springs
any.text: You asked for one Springs and the GPS picked another. The voice does not apologize.
any.saved_text: The GPS offers the wrong Springs. The atlas disagrees, and the atlas wins.

any.name: Flat tire
any.text: BANG. The tire gives up. Without a spare, you wait half a day for a rancher who lectures you the entire time.
any.saved_text: BANG. You swap in the spare and are rolling again before anyone can offer unhelpful advice.

any.name: Overheating
any.text: The radiator hose splits. You lose a day while a man named 'Doc', who is not a doctor, works on it.
any.saved_text: The radiator hose splits. Duct tape. Obviously. Nobody even has to discuss it.

any.name: Dead battery
any.text: The battery is flat because somebody charged a leaf blower off it. You pay a stranger for a jump.
any.saved_text: The battery is flat. Your jumper cables and a passing minivan solve it.

any.name: Gas station burrito
any.text: {name} ate a burrito that had been rotating since spring. There is no toilet paper. We will not discuss the sock.
any.saved_text: {name} ate a burrito that had been rotating since spring. Your foresight in paper goods saves the entire trip.

any.name: Cousin Dwayne calls
any.text: Dwayne needs $75 wired immediately for reasons involving a canoe and 'a guy'. You cave.

any.name: Very awake stranger
any.text: A man with no sleep and six teeth 'fixes' your engine for free. It now uses more gas and plays one radio station.

any.name: Twisted ankle
any.text: {name} attempts a tailgate backflip. It goes about how you'd think.
any.saved_text: {name} attempts a tailgate backflip. The first-aid kit earns its keep.

any.name: Long silent stretch
any.text: The radio dies and your party runs out of things to say. Someone starts humming. It gets ugly.
any.saved_text: The radio dies, so {name} plays the banjo. Badly. Spirits somehow soar.

any.name: Scratch ticket
any.text: {name} wins on a scratch ticket and is immediately unbearable about it.

any.name: Roadside jerky
any.text: A rancher's widow hands you a sack of homemade jerky and refuses to say what animal.

highway.name: Crosswind
highway.text: A gust launches your cooler lid, then your snacks, toward Nebraska.

highway.name: Speed trap
highway.text: A trooper clocks you, then spends an hour searching the truck. He finds only fourteen empty energy drinks. Ticket.

highway.name: Wind closure
highway.text: The highway closes for wind. You spend a day at a truck stop watching a semi nap on its side.

basin.name: Crystal salesman
basin.text: A twitchy man at a pullout sells you 'healing crystals'. They are rock salt. It is the safest thing he's ever sold.

basin.name: Pronghorn standoff
basin.text: Forty pronghorn block the road and stare. You burn gas idling until they get bored.

basin.name: Raccoon heist
basin.text: A raccoon unzips the grub box like it's done this before. It has.

mountain.name: July blizzard
mountain.text: It snows. In whatever month this is. You sit it out in the cab, sharing one blanket and many regrets.

mountain.name: Curious bear
mountain.text: A bear opens the cooler and then the truck. Everyone leaves through the other door. Some knees are skinned.
mountain.saved_text: A bear approaches. One puff of bear spray and it remembers an appointment.

mountain.name: Steep grade
mountain.text: The truck climbs at a walking pace, drinking fuel like it's free.

valley.name: Hot dog stand
valley.text: A roadside stand sells suspiciously cheap hot dogs. Everyone is thrilled, for now.

valley.name: Mosquitoes
valley.text: Mosquitoes the size of grouse. {name} loses a noticeable amount of blood.

park.name: Bison jam
park.text: Bison stroll down the road. You wait, engine running, and nobody pets the fluffy cows.

park.name: Selfie incident
park.text: {name} tries for an elk selfie. The elk has opinions.
park.saved_text: {name} tries for an elk selfie. You wave the bear spray and {name} thinks better of it.
